hypothesis: Even after applying the isUserLoggedIn() gate in triggerReauthPrompt() and ensureValidSession() visitor purge, an unauthenticated visitor visiting the website could still trigger a reauth broadcast or have their login flow locked by a failed cooldown.

Despite importing isUserLoggedIn() from @/lib/auth-session, SessionReauthModal's event listener still allows an unauthenticated visitor to see the 'In-Place Re-authentication Required' modal on initial page mount.

Despite the check 'db_ver > 1 and session.token_version < db_ver', an adversary possessing an expired or stale pre-rotation JWT can still bypass the check and force the backend to execute key rotation to a higher version.
